## 2. Applicable Test Categories

| Category | Applies | Rationale | Tool (Detected / Recommended) | Priority |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Unit tests | Yes / No | [e.g., Core business logic present] | [e.g., pytest — detected in pyproject.toml] | High |
| Integration tests | Yes / No | [e.g., External API dependencies] | [e.g., pytest + httpx — recommended] | High |
| E2E tests | Yes / No | [e.g., UI-facing feature with user journeys] | [e.g., Playwright — recommended] | Medium |
| SAST | Yes | Always applies | Semgrep — invoked ad-hoc | Critical |
| Dependency scan | Yes | Always applies | [e.g., pip-audit — detected requirements.txt] | Critical |
| IaC scan | Yes / No | [e.g., Terraform files detected under infra/] | [e.g., checkov — invoked ad-hoc] | High |
| Secret detection | Yes | Always applies | gitleaks — invoked ad-hoc | Critical |
| Load testing | Yes / No | [e.g., PRT NFR: p95 < 200ms at 500 RPS] | [e.g., k6 — recommended] | Medium |
| Accessibility | Yes / No | [e.g., context.is_ui_facing = true] | [e.g., axe-core + Lighthouse — recommended] | Medium |
| Bundle analysis | Yes / No | [e.g., React frontend detected] | [e.g., webpack-bundle-analyzer — recommended] | Low |

## 3. Tools Summary

### Detected (already configured — will use as-is)

| Tool | Config File | Version | Category |
|---|---|---|---|
| [e.g., pytest] | `pyproject.toml` | [e.g., 7.4.0] | Unit / Integration |
| [e.g., eslint] | `.eslintrc.json` | [e.g., 8.x] | Linting |
| [e.g., jest] | `jest.config.js` | [e.g., 29.x] | Unit |

### Recommended (will invoke ad-hoc)

| Tool | Category | Install Command | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| semgrep | SAST | `pip install semgrep` | Will run with `p/owasp-top-ten` + language ruleset |
| gitleaks | Secret detection | `brew install gitleaks` | Git-aware; scans history |
| [e.g., checkov] | IaC scan | `pip install checkov` | Only if context.has_iac = true |
| [e.g., k6] | Load testing | `brew install k6` | Only if performance targets defined |
| [e.g., axe-core] | Accessibility | `npm install -D axe-core` | Only if context.is_ui_facing = true |

## 4. Gaps Identified

| Gap | Severity | Phase Affected | Recommendation |
|---|---|---|---|
| [e.g., No integration tests exist for the payments module] | Blocking | Phase 2 (Quality Gate) | Write integration tests covering the 3 payment flows before re-running |
| [e.g., No .gitleaks.toml allowlist — may produce false positives on test fixtures] | Advisory | Phase 1 (Security) | Add `.gitleaks.toml` with allowlist entries before first scan |
| [e.g., No PRT found — using default thresholds] | Advisory | Phase 2 | Create PRT to specify explicit coverage and performance targets |

---

## 5. Execution Order

1. **Phase 1 — Security Scanning** (~15 min): SAST, dependency scan, IaC scan (if applicable), secret detection
2. **Phase 2 — Quality Gate** (~10 min): Test execution, coverage, lint, complexity, duplication, standards compliance
3. **Phase 3 — Performance & Accessibility** (~20 min): Load test (if applicable), Lighthouse/axe (if UI-facing), bundle analysis (if frontend)
4. **Phase 4 — Compliance & Clearance** (~5 min): Compliance matrix, accepted risks, deployment-clearance.md generation

**Estimated total duration:** ~50 min (phases 1–4, all applicable)

| Metric | Target | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Line coverage | [e.g., 80%] | [e.g., Default — Standard tier] |
| Branch coverage | [e.g., 70%] | [e.g., Default — Standard tier] |
| Auth path coverage | [e.g., 90% line / 80% branch] | [e.g., Default — Production-critical tier] |
| p95 response time | [e.g., < 200ms] | [e.g., PRT Section 7 NFR] |
| Max RPS (sustained) | [e.g., 500 RPS] | [e.g., PRT Section 7 NFR] |
| Error rate under load | [e.g., < 0.1%] | [e.g., Default] |
